rule_references.scope: Official Seedling1/5 and Blossom2/10 printed values, three-turn text.
Firsthand community report: Seedling counts holder ends; Rhythm counts holder starts. Not CN calibration.
Player report: next-turn temporary mana is not permanent and cannot be refreshed.
Community notes: remove min(permanent crystals, available spaces), empty first; ignore temporary; resolve each summon reaction. References developer/video, not CN calibration.

local_rules.hidden_deadline: Two/four actual controller starts, independent ordinary PlayerEffect deadlines. Opponent receives neither private effect key nor countdown through DTO/event projection. Accepted hand branch stays private through existing projection; actual summons reveal results.
local_rules.wither: Freeze the current friendly living Undead group; each original live recipient takes up to1 current Attack/remaining Health from the original minion. Commit debit and credit before notifications, then normal death checkpoint. Self transfer is a no-op, departed/transformed/control-changed original references expire; exact CN reaction order deferred.
local_rules.blossom: Use the existing three actual holder-end hand-progress policy. Opponent turns and deck residence do not count. Current/base copy, resets and same-event discipline stay in the common engine.
local_rules.embrace: One original Choose One tutor slot. Forged reward binds combined choice to the same original live HAND residence and supported physical activation origins; no replacement child or reaction extra. Existing same-entity draw transformation policy retained; exact CN replacement/burn boundaries deferred.
local_rules.living_mana: Freeze min(permanent max_mana, actual board space), remove those crystals by the existing empty-first operation, then make that many ordinary named summon attempts. Temporary mana excluded. The normal current death controller receives the native empty-crystal refund, subject to cap and silence.
local_rules.trail_mix: One controller-next-start sigil per effect adds two ordinary temporary mana, without increasing max_mana; spending, refill, over-cap and expiry use existing accounts.
